newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Nov car output rises vs 95, down on Oct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Nov car output rises vs 95, down on Oct.

text.p: Argentine auto production in November was 38.5 percent higher than the same month last year at 31,794, but fell 1.7 percent versus October this year, the industry lobby ADEFA said Thursday.
Domestic car sales in November reached 34,525, an increase of 35 percent on November 1995 and of 3.5 percent on October this year, ADEFA said.
Exports for the month increased 177.7 percent from the same month last year to 12,678, which was 5.1 percent less than the previous month.
